design.motif: A satin composite electronics substrate: shallow orthogonal etched copper-like channels, small circular via depressions and staggered rectangular solder-mask zones. Subtle controlled relief, not glowing cyberpunk traces, readable circuit labels or a functional schematic. Keep routes sparse and purposeful.

description.en: Shallow orthogonal etched copper-like channels, small circular via depressions and staggered rectangular solder-mask zones.
description.zh: 复合板上的浅刻通道、小孔与错位覆膜区保留电路材质的秩序，避免发光线条压过主视觉。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: A sci-fi dashboard kit for interfaces that feel like a glimpse into the digital world.
description.zh: 带有科幻气息的仪表盘组件，让界面像是数字世界的一扇窗口。

purpose.en: Reuse terminal-inspired controls, charts, and page templates to build green-on-black data dashboards.
purpose.zh: 复用终端风格的控件、图表和页面模板，搭建绿黑配色的数据看板。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
